visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide eye-level shot of a MUJI (無印良品) storefront. Passers-by walk in front of the entrance while large pink and white text overlays appear. The setting is a brightly lit indoor shopping mall with a clean, minimalist aesthetic. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a hand reaching into a wooden shelf filled with skincare products. It picks up a clear bottle with a dark brown pump labeled 'Aging Care Decollete Milk' with a 'TESTER' sticker. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the product details. (3) The scene shifts to a hand holding a lip gloss tube. It then swatches two different shades—a pink and an orange-red—onto the back of another hand. The background shows a display of various cosmetic items on a wooden retail counter. (4) A vertical rack displays multiple pairs of strappy sandals in beige and black. A hand selects a beige pair. This is followed by a POV shot of a person's foot wearing the sandal, stepping on a light-colored wooden floor to show its flexibility. (5) The camera moves to a display of sunglasses packaged in brown paper envelopes. A hand points at several before picking up a pair with round tortoiseshell frames and yellow-tinted lenses. The background remains the consistent wooden interior of the store. (6) A hand is seen feeling the texture of white gauze trousers hanging on a clothing rack among other navy and grey pairs. The hand pinches the thin, crinkled fabric to emphasize its lightweight quality. (7) The final scene shows a wide view of the store's interior with shelves full of bags and hats. A bright graphic screen appears at the end, featuring social media logos, QR codes, and contact handles for 'japanuts'.
